subject: aerospace-materials-1
title: Aerospace Materials I — Assessment Test III (Midterm 3)
note: Assessment Test III of 16 December 2020 (Model B and Paper B) has Part I (10 test questions with four options and one right answer: +0.5 right, -0.15 wrong, 0 blank, floor 0; 5 points) and Part II (one 5-point composite-materials problem). For 2026-27 Test 3 covers Topics 8, 9, 10 and 11 (ceramics, polymers, composites and adhesives), so the default mode draws 3 + 3 + 2 + 2 questions and one composites problem. The 2020 paper mix mode draws 4 + 3 + 3 across Units 8 to 10, while the custom modes let you pick any subset of units or practise Unit 8, 9 or 10 problem types. No paper prints a duration; 60 minutes is the standard here.

provenance.structure_source: sources/cuatrimestre-1/02-aerospace-materials-1/examenes/MATERIALS_THIRDPARTIAL_2020.pdf and MATERIALS_THIRDPARTIAL_2020_V2.pdf (Assessment Test III of 16 December 2020, Model B and Paper B: Part I 10 multiple-choice questions for 5 points with +0.5/-0.15/0 and floor 0; Part II one 5-point composite-materials problem).
provenance.duration_source: Not printed on either 2020 paper. Schedule_MAT AERO I 2026 - 27.pdf (p. 2, Session 26) lists 'TEST 3 (Topics 8, 9, 10 and 11)' as one session. 60 minutes is an assumption.
provenance.verify_when: The official duration and topic weights of the current course's Test 3 are confirmed; update this file and drop this note.
provenance.problem_archetypes_source: 2012-2017 final exams (MATERIALS_FINALEXAM_2012_ORD.pdf through MATERIALS_FINALEXAM_2017_EXTRA.pdf) and 2020 Test 3 papers (MATERIALS_THIRDPARTIAL_2020.pdf, MATERIALS_THIRDPARTIAL_2020_V2.pdf) for Unit 8 ceramic structure, Unit 9 polymer molecular weight and crystallinity, and Unit 10 composite-materials problems.

content_scope_source: Units 8 to 11: ceramic materials, polymers, composite materials, adhesives (Sessions 16, 18 to 24).

parts.label: Part I — Test
parts.description: Ten questions with four options and one right answer. Right +0.5, wrong -0.15, blank 0; the mark of the test is never below 0.

parts.label: Part II — Problem · Composite materials
parts.description: One composite-materials problem (unidirectional rule of mixtures, hybrid specific properties, or fiber selection and inverse volume fraction), with three to four parts.

modes.label: Full Midterm 3 (Units 8–11)
modes.description: The 2026-27 scope: 3 + 3 + 2 + 2 questions (Units 8, 9, 10, 11) and one Part II composite-materials problem (5 points).

modes.label: 2020 paper mix (Units 8–10)
modes.description: The December 2020 Test III mix: 4 + 3 + 3 questions (Units 8, 9, 10) and one Part II composite-materials problem (5 points).

modes.label: Custom test practice (choose units)
modes.description: Pick one, two, three or all four units (Units 8 to 11) and the number of questions, spread evenly across your selection. Timed with the real penalty or corrected as you answer.

modes.label: Part II & final problems practice
modes.description: Practise Unit 10 composite problems, Unit 8 ceramic crystal structure problems, or Unit 9 polymer problems, timed and graded part by part.
